description: Output of the AI pull-request review. Shared by every provider; post_review.py validates it before posting.

verdict.description: needs_changes if any blocker or major finding exists, otherwise looks_good.

summary.description: Two to six sentences: what the change does and the most important risks. Markdown allowed.

findings.description: At most 10 findings, most severe first. Empty when there is nothing to report.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the file, exactly as in the diff header (b/ side, without the b/ prefix).

line.description: Line number in the NEW version of the file. Must be an added or context line of a diff hunk to be posted inline; use 0 for file-level findings.

body.description: What is wrong and why it matters, with a concrete input that triggers it when possible. Markdown allowed.

suggestion.description: A concrete fix (prose or a short code snippet). Empty string if none.
